Estimated meal: two fried eggs (about 90 kcal each, roughly 180 total), one English muffin (about 130 kcal), and a bowl of canned peaches in juice (about 120 kcal), plus water.

Served: 180 + 130 + 120 = 430 kcal.

Leftover: the plate has only a little egg yolk smear, about 10 kcal. The bowl holds some peach juice, about 20 kcal. Total about 30 kcal.

Eaten: 430 − 30 = 400 kcal.

Macros for what was eaten:
- Protein: eggs about 12 g, muffin about 5 g, peaches about 1 g, so about 18 g.
- Carbohydrate: muffin about 25 g, peaches about 28 g, eggs about 1 g, so about 54 g. Subtracting some leftover juice sugar gives about 50 g.
- Fat: eggs about 14 g (fried in oil or butter), muffin about 1 g, plus a little butter on the muffin, so about 15 g.
